verdict.rationale: Kick documents native invoicing: it syncs invoices from Stripe, Mercury and BILL and lets you create and send invoices directly. Nothing in the evidence shows recurring invoice schedules or automatic payment reminders for overdue customers. One-off invoice creation is not a recurring schedule, and the rules engine applies only to transaction categorization, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set up recurring invoices and automatic payment reminders for overdue customers
